title: Connection Point Attributes
description: Defines the attributes of part connection points, including position, type, tag restrictions, joint attributes, signal transmission, etc. Connection points are used for physical connections and signal transmission between parts.

locator.description: Locator name corresponding to the connection point, will search for Locators with matching names, using their position and orientation as the connection point's position and orientation.

type.description: Connection point type. AttachPoint: simple connection point; Special: special connection point, supports complex joint attributes.

normal.description: Normal direction of the connection point, used to determine the connection direction.

integrity.description: Basic structural integrity of the part, the part can withstand impact forces not exceeding this value without detaching, impact forces come from damage or joint stress.

impact_reduction.description: Impact reduction value of the connection point, applied before calculating part detachment, can reduce impact to 0 to completely avoid effects on structural integrity.

impact_multiplier.description: Impact absorption rate of the connection point, applied after impact reduction before calculating part detachment, greater than 1 will make the connection point easier to break.

required_tags.description: Tags that the connecting part must all have, leave empty to allow any tags. For example: ["variant:left"] means must include left variant tag.

acceptable_tags.description: Tags that the connecting part must have at least one of, leave empty to allow any tags. For example: ["door", "hatch"] means must include one of door or hatch tags.

forbidden_tags.description: Tags that the connecting part must not contain, leave empty to allow any tags. For example: ["explosive"] means cannot include explosive tag.

joint_attrs.description: Joint attributes, currently only effective when joint type is Special. Keys are x, y, z, xr, yr, zr, representing translation along x, y, z axes and rotation around x, y, z axes respectively.

signal_translations.description: Signal channel translation rules received from the opposite connection point, for example: {"channel_a": "channel_c"} means translating channel_a signal to channel_c.

signal_targets.description: Control signal transmission targets of the connection point within this part, key is signal channel, value is target list (subsystem/connection point name/part/vehicle). For example: {"move_control": ["car_controller", "engine"]}.

collide_between_parts.description: Whether the connection point allows collision between parts. Usually set to false to avoid penetration issues between connection points.

connected_to.description: Name of the connection point within the part that this connection point defaults to connecting to (not bone name!). Leave empty to not default connect. For example: "hull" means default connects to the connection point named hull.

examples.description: Left front wheel connection point, only allows left variant, has vertical suspension and steering capability
